plan.fault: Workflow coordinator exits after committed dependency activation before returning its ACK
plan.control_state: Native Unix-only PG17 on existing container disk, not Azure or Pod-loss durable
plan.model_tasks: Existing four-H100 480B-total/35B-active MoE, Batch API, Azure ledger and S3

guard_scope: Existing guard unmodified; unknown campaign lock waits, no automatic recovery coverage claimed

actual_client_readback.scope: Actual same-origin client verifies workflow declarations, complete event/snapshot chains, source membership/lineage and current child receipts; not semantic correctness or browser visual QA
